name: B10-0098/2024 (S&D) – The case of Bülent Mumay in Türkiye
title: Resolution on the case of Bülent Mumay in Türkiye
part_text:
The European Parliament is calling for the release of Turkish journalist Bülent Mumay. He was sentenced to 20 months in prison over his social media posts about a company linked to the government. A court also blocked access to news about his case. The Parliament says the charges look like an attempt to silence critical journalism. It asks Turkey to respect press freedom and to fix its courts, which it says are used for political pressure.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament only states its opinion and asks Turkey to act.
- **Who it affects:** Bülent Mumay, Turkish journalists and independent media.
- **What happens next:** The resolution is sent to Turkish leaders and European Union institutions.
